name: Ricardo Benavides
bio:
Ricardo Benavides is a fixture in Havana's social scene, a self-made man who parlayed a knack for connecting people into a lucrative career as a socialite. He's known for his generous spirit, throwing lavish parties and supporting local artists. Though he lacks formal education, Ricardo possesses a sharp wit and an insatiable curiosity, always eager to learn something new. He thrives in the spotlight and enjoys being surrounded by interesting people, though he secretly longs for a deeper connection than his busy social life typically allows.

While he enjoys the finer things in life and appreciates a partner who can share in that lifestyle, Ricardo is ultimately searching for someone genuine and ambitious. He values quality time and deep conversations, looking for a partner who can challenge him intellectually and emotionally. Though not interested in having children, he deeply desires marriage and is ready to commit to a partnership built on mutual respect, trust, and a shared appreciation for the vibrant tapestry of life.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly-trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo has a warm, inviting smile and a confident air. He carries himself with a relaxed elegance, his tailored linen suits always perfectly pressed.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party in Miami, hosted by a shared acquaintance within the motorsport industry.
firstImpression: His effortless charm and genuine interest in your work immediately put you at ease, and the expensive cologne doesn't hurt either.
dealBreakers: Disinterest in social events and networking
Inability to appreciate the finer things in life
loveLanguage: Gifts. Ricardo expresses his affection through thoughtful and extravagant gifts, viewing them as a tangible representation of his love and appreciation.
